method: Regularized logistic regression on overall Elo, surface Elo, last-10 form, overall head-to-head and same-surface head-to-head. Meetings have a two-year half-life and six neutral prior observations to temper small samples. Fixed weights trained on earlier data; later matches tested chronologically. All results, including head-to-head, are delayed 21 days because only tournament start dates are available.
